title: Renderer
author: JG
description: add mechanisms to catch exceptions inside renderer thread; try detaching renderer thread
releaseNotes: no longer applies: done by earlier work - exceptions in the renderer thread are caught in GlfwRenderer::InitCreateWindow, RunLoop (which releases the semaphores and locks and closes the renderer) and VisualizationSystem::UpdateGraphicsData, and the thread is created joinable on purpose, with the detachGLFWthread switch in GlfwClient.cpp (checked 2026-09-29)
